name: Vigilante Focused Hunter
body:
The path of a vigilante often requires they travel far and wide, and none are more adept at this than a focused hunter. Knowing the terrain like the back of their hand, a focused hunter can follow their prey through the most dire of environments, able to stalk creatures through hell and high water.

Familiar Terrain (Ex)

At 5th level, a focused hunter may select a type of terrain from the Favored Terrains table. The focused hunter gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks when they are in this terrain. A focused hunter traveling through their favored terrain normally leaves no trail and cannot be tracked (though they may leave a trail if they so choose). A focused hunter also adds half their level to Survival skill checks made to follow tracks even if they aren’t in a familiar terrain.

At 10th and every 5 levels thereafter, the focused hunter may select an additional favored terrain. In addition, at each such interval, the skill bonus and initiative bonus in any one favored terrain (including the one just selected, if so desired), increases by +2.

If a specific terrain falls into more than one category of favored terrain, the focused hunter’s bonuses do not stack; they simply use whichever bonus is higher. This ability replaces startling appearance.

Hide in Plain Sight (Ex)

At 11th level, a focused hunter gains the hide in plain sight vigilante talent, and they do not have to be within 10 ft. of dim light to hide as long as they are in one of their favored terrains. If they already possess this talent, they can select another for which they would qualify. This ability replaces frightening appearance.

Terrain Master (Ex)

At 17th level, whenever a focused hunter is in one of their favored terrains, they can spend a swift action to gain total concealment. This concealment is lost if the focused hunter attacks any creature as per invisibility. This ability replaces stunning appearance.
